  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')

    // Apply theme and update storage if needed
    function applyTheme(theme) {
      const isDark =
        theme === 'dark' || (theme === 'system' && mediaQuery.matches)
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', isDark)
      theme !== 'system' && localStorage.setItem('theme', theme)
    }

    // Event listeners for theme changes
    mediaQuery.addEventListener(
      'change',
      () =>
        (localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'system') === 'system' &&
        applyTheme('system'),
    )

    window.addEventListener(
      'storage',
      ({ key, newValue }) => key === 'theme' && applyTheme(newValue),
    )

    // Observer to sync DOM class changes with storage
    new MutationObserver(() => {
      const currentTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme')
      if (currentTheme !== 'system') {
        localStorage.setItem(
          'theme',
          document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')
            ? 'dark'
            : 'light',
        )
      }
    }).observe(document.documentElement, {
      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ['class'],
    })
  })
